items.title: Adobe Commerce Account Takeover via Session Identity Flaw
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated remote attackers to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. Exploitation attempts have been detected in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) in Adobe Commerce could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 7.7) could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.6) affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical unrestricted file upload vulnerability allows malicious files to be uploaded to the server, potentially leading to privilege escalation. This was addressed in APSB26-73.

items.title: Improper Output Encoding leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This critical vulnerability involves improper output encoding, which could lead to arbitrary code execution through targeted attacks via webhooks. It was patched in APSB26-73.

items.title: Stored XSS leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical stored XSS vulnerability allows injecting malicious scripts in the backend, potentially leading to privilege escalation. This issue was resolved with APSB26-73.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This critical incorrect authorization vulnerability allows bypassing default system rules, leading to a security feature bypass. It was addressed in APSB26-73.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Unauthorized Access
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability enables unauthorized access to resources, resulting in a security feature bypass. This was fixed as part of APSB26-73.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes (CVSS 9.3) allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution. Amasty released version 4.0.0 to fix this issue, and exploitation attempts have been observed in the wild.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a Magento extension, which can lead to remote code execution. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw (CVSS 7.5) in Adobe Commerce allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access. This vulnerability affects multiple versions of Adobe Commerce.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered PolyShell, a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files by disguising code as an image. While a fix was included in Magento 2.4.9, older supported versions remain vulnerable without backported patches.
